sql: select 'fill' k, f.market_ticker t, f.side, f.action, f.price::text p, f.quantity::text q, coalesce(f.raw_fill_json->>'created_time','') ts, left(f.raw_fill_json::text, 400) raw from fills f where coalesce(f.raw_fill_json->>'created_time','') between '2026-09-25T14:20' and '2026-09-25T14:50' union all select 'obs', to_char(b.at,'HH24:MI:SS'), b.balance_cents::text, coalesce(b.residual_cents::text,'-'), b.fills_counted::text, b.settlements_counted::text, '', left(coalesce(b.reconciliation_json::text, b.notes_json::text,''),400) from incentive_balance_observations b where b.at between '2026-09-25 14:20' and '2026-09-25 14:50' union all select 'ev', kind, to_char(at,'HH24:MI:SS'), '', '', '', '', left(coalesce(detail_json::text, detail, ''),300) from incentive_collector_events where kind='reward_residual' and at > now() - interval '3 hours' order by 1, 7
